name: Reaction Pathways Benchmark Dataset
description: Provides a large dataset to evaluate reinforcement learning algorithms' ability to find chemical reaction pathways, measuring success rate and sample efficiency.
general_score_metric: success_rate (often reported alongside sample efficiency / steps-to-solution)
reputation: New domain-specific benchmark (ChemRxiv) aimed at the RL-for-chemistry community; early-stage adoption among researchers working on automated reaction discovery.
notes: Non-LLM, environment-dependent benchmark; computationally expensive to evaluate (simulation/quantum calculations). Results sensitive to simulator fidelity and reward design; potential for dataset/environment contamination if policy training uses similar reaction data.
